outline: The goal of this course is to improve the reading and writing ability of graduate student. The contents include general formats of sentences, vocabularies, reading skill, and infrastructure of English report and academic papers.

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: Every student will study one topic and accomplish the report.
flexible_learning.outcome: The learning outcome will illustrate through the topic report.

assessment:
Regular grades: 40% (including attendance, writing exercises, reports, etc.)
Midterm exam: 30%
Final exam: 30%
